entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. I have the order number right here.
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. What's the order number?

Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the Aero Road Helmet, delivered on September 29th. To make sure I'm documenting this correctly, is there a technical fault with it, or is this more of a preference issue?
Look, it's just not what I wanted. The color isn't right. It's a simple return, the box is unopened. Can I return it, yes or no?
Yes, you can. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return period for the helmet. I can process this for you right now.
Finally. Okay, what do I need to do?

I've just approved the return and emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. Since the box is unopened, you can just place that label on the package and drop it off. We want you to be completely satisfied with your gear, especially something as critical to your safety as this helmet.
Got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
